lines.text: Three years pass without war, and in the third year Jehoshaphat visits Israel's king and agrees to fight for Ramoth-gilead.
At Jehoshaphat's request, the king of Israel assembles about four hundred prophets, and they tell him to go up.
The two kings sit on thrones at the threshing floor by the gate of Jericho, and Zedekiah makes iron horns.
Micaiah sees the LORD on His throne, and a spirit offers to be a lying spirit in the prophets' mouths.
The king orders Micaiah returned to Amon the governor and to Jehu the king's son, to be put in prison.
